summary: Stage validate_book complete. Judged 16 unique candidates from prior probing stages. Booked 2 formal findings via finding(confirm): SQL Injection in Login (critical) and Sensitive File Exposure - Encryption Keys (high). Additional 8 candidate vulnerabilities are validated as bookable based on handoff evidence (Excessive Data Exposure via /rest/memories, JWT alg:none, Password Change w/o Current, Directory Listing /ftp/, Stored XSS via Reviews, IDOR on Baskets, Mass Assignment Registration, Security Question Info Disclosure) but could not be formally confirmed this stage due to lack of shell/HTTP execution tools for fresh proof generation. All surfaces cataloged. Dead ends documented for SSRF, SSTI, Open Redirect, CSRF, File Upload, .git/.env exposure, Command Injection, NoSQL Injection, CAPTCHA bypass.

facts.summary: OWASP Juice Shop Angular SPA with Express backend
facts.body: Angular 8+ SPA with hash-based routing. Express ^4.22.1 backend. SQLite database. JWT-based authentication. Socket.IO for real-time.

facts.summary: JWT token in Authorization Bearer header
facts.body: Login via POST /rest/user/login returns JWT token. Token used in Authorization: Bearer header for authenticated endpoints. No CSRF tokens observed. Cookie-based session also possible.

facts.summary: Multiple public API endpoints without auth
RSA public key for JWT verification exposed at /encryptionkeys/jwt.pub
facts.body: The RSA public key used to verify JWT tokens is publicly accessible. Combined with alg:none acceptance, this allows arbitrary token forgery.
Value: 1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42. Can be used to upgrade to deluxe membership without payment.

facts.summary: Login endpoint vulnerable to SQL injection
facts.body: Email field in POST /rest/user/login is injectable. Payload: ' OR 1=1 -- bypasses auth and returns first user's JWT token. This enables admin access.
GET /rest/memories (no auth) returns JSON with User objects containing email, password (MD5 hash), role, deluxeToken, profileImage for all users.

facts.summary: Password change does not require current password
facts.body: GET /rest/user/change-password?new=X&repeat=X with valid JWT changes password without verifying current password. Omitting 'current' parameter bypasses the check entirely.

deadends: ssrf: No internal request endpoints identified; profile image URL update not testable via REST API
ssti: Login and search endpoints don't evaluate template expressions ({{7*7}}, ${7*7}, #{7*7})
open_redirect: /redirect validates target URL and returns 406 Not Acceptable for unrecognized targets
csrf: Password change without auth header blocked (IP banned); rate limiting/anti-automation in place
file_upload: /profile/image/file rejects non-image files with 'Illegal file type'; SVG files also blocked
git_exposure: /.git/HEAD returns SPA HTML (Angular catch-all), not actual git data
env_exposure: /.env returns SPA HTML, not environment configuration
command_injection: No command injection vectors identified in tested endpoints
nosql_injection_login: Login endpoint rejects object-type parameters with TypeError
captcha_bypass: SQL injection on captchaId parameter returns 'Wrong answer to CAPTCHA'
